```{r initiate}
rm(list = ls())
# 0a.Declare root directory, folder location and load essential stuff
project.folder = paste0(print(here::here()), '/')
source(paste0(project.folder, 'create_folder_structure.R'))
source(paste0(functions.folder, 'script_initiate.R'))
```

# 1. Load daily panel and aggregate to weekly (zone × week)

```{r aggregate-weekly}
daily <- readRDS(paste0(objects_folder, "fishnet_timeseries_daily_modeling.RDS"))
setDT(daily)
setkey(daily, zone_id, date)

# Unit conversion (m → mm) — guarded
if (max(daily$runoff, na.rm = TRUE) < 1) {
  daily[, runoff        := runoff        * 1000]
  daily[, precipitation := precipitation * 1000]
}

# Weekly key
daily[, week_id := paste0(lubridate::isoyear(date), "-W",
                          formatC(lubridate::isoweek(date), width = 2, flag = "0"))]
daily[, dow := lubridate::wday(date, week_start = 1)]   # Monday=1; for bird anchoring

weekly <- daily[, .(
  week_start          = min(date),
  week_end            = max(date),
  year                = lubridate::isoyear(min(date)),
  month               = lubridate::month(min(date)),
  outbreak_binary     = as.integer(any(outbreak_binary == 1)),
  birds_au            = first(birds_au),                   # poultry animal-units; zone-fixed
  temperature         = mean(temperature,         na.rm = TRUE),
  soil_moisture       = mean(soil_moisture,       na.rm = TRUE),
  snow_cover          = mean(snow_cover,          na.rm = TRUE),
  wind_speed          = mean(wind_speed,          na.rm = TRUE),
  anseriformes        = {                                     # Monday-anchored (weekly anchor, no smearing)
    m_vals <- .SD[dow == 1, anseriformes]
    if (length(m_vals) > 0 && !is.na(m_vals[1])) m_vals[1] else first(.SD$anseriformes)
  },
  precipitation       = sum(precipitation,        na.rm = TRUE),
  runoff              = sum(runoff,               na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(zone_id, week_id)]

setkey(weekly, zone_id, week_start)

# log1p + z-scale (match daily / weekly clogit transformations)
weekly[, runoff        := log1p(runoff)]
weekly[, precipitation := log1p(precipitation)]
weekly[, snow_cover    := snow_cover / 100]                       # already 0-1 fraction, no log1p needed
weekly[, anseriformes  := log1p(anseriformes)]
weekly[, birds_au_z    := as.numeric(scale(log1p(birds_au)))]     # log1p + z (right-skewed: a few large CAFOs dominate)
for (v in c("runoff", "soil_moisture", "temperature",
            "precipitation", "wind_speed", "snow_cover", "anseriformes")) {
  weekly[[v]] <- as.numeric(scale(weekly[[v]]))
}

# Restrict to case window
weekly <- weekly[year == 2022]

cat("Weekly panel — zone-weeks (2022): ", nrow(weekly),
    " | case-weeks: ", sum(weekly$outbreak_binary == 1),
    " | case zones: ", uniqueN(weekly[outbreak_binary == 1]$zone_id),
    "\n", sep = "")
```

# 2. Build (zone, tstart, tstop, event) intervals for Andersen–Gill

```{r ag-intervals}
setorder(weekly, zone_id, week_start)
weekly[, `:=`(
  tstart = seq_len(.N) - 1L,
  tstop  = seq_len(.N),
  event  = as.integer(outbreak_binary),
  stratum_month = month
), by = zone_id]

case_zones <- weekly[event == 1, unique(zone_id)]
ag_panel   <- weekly[zone_id %in% case_zones]
cat("AG panel — rows: ", nrow(ag_panel),
    " | zones: ", uniqueN(ag_panel$zone_id),
    " | events: ", sum(ag_panel$event == 1),
    "\n", sep = "")
```

# 3. Build weekly crossbases (lag 0–4 weeks, ns df=2)

```{r weekly-crossbases}
MAX_LAG_WK <- 4

cb_runoff <- crossbasis(
  ag_panel$runoff, lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK),
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2),
  group  = ag_panel$zone_id
)
cb_soil_moisture <- crossbasis(
  ag_panel$soil_moisture, lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK),
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2),
  group  = ag_panel$zone_id
)
cb_temperature <- crossbasis(
  ag_panel$temperature, lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK),
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2),
  group  = ag_panel$zone_id
)
cb_precipitation <- crossbasis(
  ag_panel$precipitation, lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK),
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2),
  group  = ag_panel$zone_id
)
cb_wind_speed <- crossbasis(
  ag_panel$wind_speed, lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK),
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2),
  group  = ag_panel$zone_id
)
cb_snow_cover <- crossbasis(
  ag_panel$snow_cover, lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK),
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2),
  group  = ag_panel$zone_id
)
cb_anseriformes <- crossbasis(
  ag_panel$anseriformes, lag = c(0, MAX_LAG_WK),
  argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2),
  group  = ag_panel$zone_id
)
```

# 4. Fit Andersen–Gill recurrent-event Cox model

```{r fit-ag}
ag_model <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~
    cb_runoff + cb_soil_moisture + cb_temperature +
    cb_precipitation + cb_wind_speed + cb_snow_cover +
    cb_anseriformes +
    birds_au_z +                                    # poultry density (zone-fixed, estimable in Cox AG)
    strata(stratum_month),
  data    = ag_panel,
  ties    = "efron",
  cluster = zone_id
)
saveRDS(ag_model, paste0(models_folder, "weekly_cox_ag_model.RDS"))
print(summary(ag_model))
```

# 5. Per-lag-week hazard ratios (+0.5 SD)

```{r per-lag-hr}
predictor_specs <- list(
  "Runoff"        = "cb_runoff",
  "Soil Moisture" = "cb_soil_moisture",
  "Temperature"   = "cb_temperature",
  "Precipitation" = "cb_precipitation",
  "Wind Speed"    = "cb_wind_speed",
  "Snow Cover"    = "cb_snow_cover",
  "Anseriformes"  = "cb_anseriformes"
)

beta <- coef(ag_model); V <- vcov(ag_model)
lag_basis <- do.call(dlnm::onebasis,
                     c(list(x = 0:MAX_LAG_WK), attr(cb_runoff, "arglag")))

per_lag <- rbindlist(lapply(names(predictor_specs), function(name) {
  prefix <- predictor_specs[[name]]
  cols   <- grep(paste0("^", prefix, "v"), names(beta))
  b      <- beta[cols]; Vsub <- V[cols, cols]
  rbindlist(lapply(0:MAX_LAG_WK, function(k) {
    contrast <- 0.5 * lag_basis[k + 1, ]
    lo  <- as.numeric(contrast %*% b)
    se  <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(contrast) %*% Vsub %*% contrast))
    data.table(
      Predictor = name,
      Lag       = paste0("Lag ", k, " wk"),
      HR_CI     = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
                          exp(lo), exp(lo - 1.96 * se), exp(lo + 1.96 * se))
    )
  }))
}))

wide_perlag <- dcast(per_lag, Predictor ~ Lag, value.var = "HR_CI")
print(wide_perlag)
```

# 6. Cumulative HR over the 0–4 week window

```{r cumulative-hr}
contrast_full <- 0.5 * colSums(lag_basis)

cum_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(predictor_specs), function(name) {
  prefix <- predictor_specs[[name]]
  cols   <- grep(paste0("^", prefix, "v"), names(beta))
  b      <- beta[cols]; Vsub <- V[cols, cols]
  lo     <- as.numeric(contrast_full %*% b)
  se     <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(contrast_full) %*% Vsub %*% contrast_full))
  data.table(
    Predictor          = name,
    `Cumulative HR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
                              exp(lo), exp(lo - 1.96 * se), exp(lo + 1.96 * se))
  )
}))

# Add the time-fixed feedlot covariate (birds_au_z) as a separate row.
# In a Cox AG with month strata, zone-fixed covariates are estimable because
# zones differ within each month-stratum.
ba_idx <- which(names(beta) == "birds_au_z")
if (length(ba_idx) == 1) {
  b_ba <- beta[ba_idx]; se_ba <- sqrt(V[ba_idx, ba_idx])
  cum_tbl <- rbind(cum_tbl, data.table(
    Predictor          = "Poultry density (birds_au, log+z, per +1 SD)",
    `Cumulative HR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
                              exp(b_ba), exp(b_ba - 1.96*se_ba), exp(b_ba + 1.96*se_ba))
  ))
}
print(cum_tbl)
```

# 7. Compare against weekly case-crossover primary

```{r compare-to-clogit}
# Load the 1:4 unidirectional results from c_20
ab <- readRDS(paste0(objects_folder, "weekly_primary_ab.RDS"))
res_A <- ab$res_A
res_B <- ab$res_B

setnames(res_A, "OR_CI", "Conditional logistic OR (95% CI)")
setnames(res_B, "OR_CI", "time-stratified clogit OR (95% CI)")

compare <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "Predictor"),
                  list(cum_tbl,
                       res_A[, .(Predictor, `Conditional logistic OR (95% CI)`)],
                       res_B[, .(Predictor, `time-stratified clogit OR (95% CI)`)]))
setnames(compare, "Cumulative HR (95% CI)", "Cox AG HR (95% CI)")
print(compare)
```

# 8. Export tables

```{r export}
ft_perlag <- wide_perlag %>%
  flextable() %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs()

doc1 <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_perlag) %>%
  body_add_par(
    paste0("Per-lag-week hazard ratios from the Andersen-Gill recurrent-event Cox model at weekly resolution (lag 0-4 weeks, ns df=2), per +0.5 SD increase in each predictor. Baseline hazard stratified by calendar month; cluster-robust SEs clustered on zone. AG panel n = ",
           nrow(ag_panel), " zone-weeks across ", uniqueN(ag_panel$zone_id), " case zones with ",
           sum(ag_panel$event == 1), " events."),
    style = "Normal"
  )
print(doc1, target = paste0(tables_main_folder, "Table_Weekly_Cox_AG_PerLag.docx"))

ft_compare <- compare %>%
  flextable() %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs()

doc2 <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_compare) %>%
  body_add_par(
    "Cumulative weekly effect estimates (per +0.5 SD, lag 0-4 weeks) across three modeling approaches on the same weekly panel (CSLT excluded): Andersen-Gill recurrent-event Cox model (HR), 1:4 unidirectional case-crossover (Conditional logistic OR), and time-stratified case-crossover (time-stratified clogit OR).",
    style = "Normal"
  )
print(doc2, target = paste0(tables_main_folder, "Table_Weekly_Cox_AG_vs_Clogit.docx"))
```

# 9. PH diagnostic

```{r ph-test}
zph_test <- tryCatch(cox.zph(ag_model, transform = "identity"),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(zph_test)) {
  print(zph_test)

  png(paste0(figures_main_folder, "figure_weekly_cox_ag_ph_diagnostic.png"),
      width = 12, height = 9, units = "in", res = 300)
  par(mfrow = c(3, 4), mar = c(4, 4, 2.5, 1))
  plot(zph_test)
  dev.off()

  ph_summary <- as.data.frame(zph_test$table) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    mutate(across(c(chisq, df, p), ~ signif(.x, 3)))

  ft_ph <- ph_summary %>%
    flextable() %>%
    fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
    autofit() %>%
    align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    theme_booktabs()

  doc3 <- read_docx() %>%
    body_add_flextable(ft_ph) %>%
    body_add_par(
      "Schoenfeld residual test for proportional hazards in the weekly Andersen-Gill Cox model. Low p-values indicate time-varying effects.",
      style = "Normal"
    )
  print(doc3, target = paste0(tables_main_folder, "Table_Weekly_Cox_AG_PH.docx"))
}
```

saveRDS(list(

  per_lag     = per_lag,

  cum_tbl     = cum_tbl,

  weekly      = weekly,
